topic: Does cooler weather change mining profit
title: Does Cooler Weather Make Mining More Profitable?
hook: Does cold weather make Bitcoin mining more profitable?

scenes.narration: Hashprice depends on the block subsidy, fees, difficulty and, in dollars, the bitcoin price.
Temperature isn't one of those inputs.
Your electricity cost and machine efficiency are separate, so check your own numbers.

cta: Does weather change your setup? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Hashprice depends on subsidy, fees, difficulty and price, not on the weather.
